sn35.116:1.1: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyan ti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:1.2: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antam dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmīti || ||
sn35.116:1.3: Idam vatvā Bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram pāvisi || || 3
sn35.116:1.4: Atha kho tesam bhikkhūnam acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi || ||
sn35.116:1.5: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:1.6: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyam pattayyam ti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:1.7: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antam dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmīti || ||
sn35.116:1.8: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajjeyyāti || || 4
sn35.116:2.1: Atha kho tesam bhikkhūnam etad ahosi || ||
sn35.116:2.2: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānanda satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ ||
sn35.116:2.3: pahoti ca āyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ ||
sn35.116:2.4: yaṃ nūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipuccheyyāmāti || || 5
sn35.116:3.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn35.116:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 6 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantam Ānandam etad avocuṃ ||
sn35.116:4.1: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Ānanda Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:4.2: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyam daṭṭhayyam pattayyan ti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:4.3: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antam dukkhassa antakiriyam vadāmīti || ||
sn35.116:4.4: Tesam no āvuso acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi || ||
sn35.116:4.5: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:4.6: Nāham bhikkhave gamaṇena lokassa antam ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyam pattayyanti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:4.7: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmī ti ||
sn35.116:4.8: ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti || ||
sn35.116:4.9: Tesaṃ no āvuso amhākam etad ahosi || ||
sn35.116:4.10: Ayaṃ kho āvuso āyasmā Ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ ||
sn35.116:4.11: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ ||
sn35.116:4.12: yaṃ nuna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipuccheyyāmāti || ||
sn35.116:5.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlam atikkamma khandhaṃ sākhāpalāse sāram pariyesitabbam maññeyya
sn35.116:5.2: evam sampadam idam āyasmantānaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte tam Bhagavantam atisitvā amhe etam attham paṭipucchitabbam maññetha || ||
sn35.116:5.3: So āvuso Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati ||
sn35.116:5.4: cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato || ||
sn35.116:5.5: So ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yam Bhagavantaṃ yeva etam attham paṭipuccheyyātha ||
sn35.116:5.6: yathā vo Bhagavā vyākareyya tathā taṃ dhāreyyathā ti || || 8
sn35.116:6.1: Addhāvuso Ānanda Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passam passati ||
sn35.116:6.2: cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato ||
sn35.116:6.3: so ceva kālo ahosi yam Bhagavantaṃ yeva etam attham paṭipuccheyyāma ||
sn35.116:6.4: yathā no Bhagavā vyākareyya tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma || ||
sn35.116:6.5: Api cāyasmā Ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ ||
sn35.116:6.6: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ ||
sn35.116:7.1: Tena hāvuso suṇātha sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn35.116:7.2: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassossuṃ || || 10
sn35.116:8.1: Yaṃ kho vo āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:8.2: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyam daṭṭhayyam pattayyanti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:8.3: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antam dukkhassa antakiriyam vadāmī ti ||
sn35.116:8.4: imassa khvāham āvuso Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthāreṇa attham avibhattassa vitthāreṇa evam ājānāmi || || 11
sn35.116:8.5: Yena kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī
sn35.116:8.7: Kena cāvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī ||
sn35.116:8.8: Cakkhunā kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī ||
sn35.116:8.11: Jivhāya kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī ||
sn35.116:8.13: Manena kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī || ||
sn35.116:8.14: Yena kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī ||
sn35.116:8.16: Yaṃ kho vo āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:8.17: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyam daṭṭhayyam pattayanti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:8.18: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmīti ||
sn35.116:8.19: imassa khvāham āvuso Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmi ||
sn35.116:8.20: ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āyasmanto Bhagavantaññeva upasaṅkamitvā etam attham paṭipuccheyyātha ||
sn35.116:8.21: yathā vo Bhagavā vyākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti || ||
sn35.116:9.1: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 13 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho ti bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn35.116:10.1: Yaṃ kho pana bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:10.2: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyam daṭṭhayyaṃ pattayyanti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:10.3: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmīti ||
sn35.116:10.4: tesaṃ no bhante amhākam acirapakkhantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi || ||
sn35.116:10.5: Idaṃ kho no āvuso Bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena attham avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāram paviṭṭho ||
sn35.116:10.6: Nāham bhikkhave gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñātayyaṃ daṭṭhayyam pattayanti vadāmi ||
sn35.116:10.7: na ca panāham bhikkhave apatvā lokassa antam dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmīti ||
sn35.116:10.8: ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajjeyyāti || 14
sn35.116:10.9: Tesaṃ no bhante amhākam etad ahosi || ||
sn35.116:10.10: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Ānando satthuceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ ||
sn35.116:10.11: pahoti cāyasmā Ānando imassa Bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ ||
sn35.116:10.12: Yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipuccheyyāmāti || ||
sn35.116:10.13: Atha kho mayam bhante yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamimha || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam etam attham paṭipucchimha || || 15
sn35.116:10.14: Tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā Ānandena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi vyañjanehi attho vibhatto ti || ||
sn35.116:11.1: Paṇḍito bhikkhave Ānando mahāpañño bhikkhave Ānando ||
sn35.116:11.2: maṃ ce pi tumhe bhikkhave etam attham paṭipuccheyyātha aham pi ca tam evam eva vyākareyyaṃ yathā tam Ānandena vyākataṃ || ||
sn35.116:11.3: Eso ceva tassa attho evaṃ ca dhāreyyāthā ti || || 2
